increments.name: Access and authentication
increments.summary: Landing page, registration, login, OTP recovery, sessions and Google access.
stages: Design
Requirements adjustment; entry-page prototypes; account, OTP and session schema; Google onboarding and account-linking flow; health-check recovery flow.
Coding
Landing page; registration/login; email verification and password recovery; staff-account creation; authenticated sessions; Google sign-in, onboarding and linking; server health and recovery screens.
Testing
Registration, expired/resend OTPs, duplicate accounts, login/recovery, sessions, Google identity linking, inactive accounts, outage recovery and user feedback.

increments.name: Profiles and access control
increments.summary: Profiles, staff/owner controls, branch permissions, schedules and activity history.
stages: Design

Requirements adjustment; role/profile interfaces; branch and feature permissions; personnel and veterinarian schedules; notification preferences; activity-history access; shared theme and refresh behavior.
Coding

Owner/staff profiles; account activation and protected removal; branch and feature restrictions; availability and clinic configuration; preferences; activity history; theme controls and quiet refresh.
Testing
Profile persistence, role/branch boundaries, feature permissions, protected accounts, schedules, activity-history privacy, preference settings, theme and responsive behavior.

increments.name: Pet profiles and medical records
increments.summary: Pet linking/co-ownership, clinical records, prescriptions, attachments and corrections.
stages: Design
Requirements adjustment; pet registration/linking and co-owner approval; clinical-record relationships; structured diagnosis and extra consent; owner visibility; record-correction workflow.
Coding

Pet profiles and ownership; EMR and diagnosis; allergy/vaccination data; prescriptions, laboratory files and attachments; extra diagnosis consent; print/email copies; controlled record updates and change notifications.
Testing

Pet linking/co-owner approval, grouped medical records, diagnosis with optional vaccination, extra consent, attachment permissions, print/email, meaningful-change notifications and correction requests.

increments.name: Bookings, consultations and payments
increments.summary: Appointments, Jitsi consultations, home service, consent, payment proof and calendar.
stages: Design

Requirements adjustment; booking/calendar interfaces; veterinarian presence, lunch and conflict rules; consultation access; home service; digital consent and proof submission; saved booking intent and personal tasks.
Coding

Service bookings; approval/rescheduling/cancellation; veterinarian availability and presence; Jitsi access and documentation; home service; consent/signatures; payment proof and verification; booking-intent recovery; personal calendar and reminder hooks.
Testing

Booking conflicts and branch/service rules; presence/lunch rules; saved booking handoff; authorized consultation access; consent/proof verification; home-service details; calendars, reminders and missed-booking handling.

increments.name: Clinic operations, billing and inventory
increments.summary: Queue/TV display, grooming, boarding, POS, service pricing and inventory.
stages: Design

Requirements adjustment; queue/public-display flow; grooming and boarding operations; service catalog and price projections; visit/POS links; stock movement, branch transfer and safe product deletion.
Coding

Network-restricted queue and TV status; grooming intake/photos/review/pickup; boarding rooms, care tasks and checkout; service catalog and estimates; POS/invoices; stock batches, expiry, deductions, transfers and safe deletion; operational notifications and lifecycle automation.
Testing

Queue consent, duplicates and assignment; TV privacy/refresh; grooming and boarding lifecycles; room conflicts; invoice/payment totals; materials/stock reversals; transfers and expiry alerts; deletion preserves history; operational notifications.

increments.name: Reporting, media and backup
increments.summary: Reports, comparisons, PDF/Excel exports, protected media and recoverable backups.
stages: Design
Requirements adjustment; KPI/report filters and comparisons; PDF/Excel layouts; media-access views; operational alerts; backup package, emergency workbook and recovery workflow.
Coding

Reporting dashboard/center; date/branch filters; comparisons and drill-downs; PDF/Excel exports; protected media and consistency checks; notification/alert integration; database/media backup, manifests/checksums and emergency workbook.
Testing

Reconcile reports/exports with source records; verify filters, comparisons, role access, protected media and alerts; inspect backup SQL/files/manifests and rehearse recovery; prepare integrated release.
